intro: Will you discover all 100 adorable hidden cats?
description:
The world around you is frozen in black and white, awaiting your touch to bring it to life. In 100 Korean Hidden Cats, you embark on a journey where your task is to bring this real world to life by finding all the hidden furry friends. Each location is designed in the style of an elegant coloring book, but within this tranquility lies a true challenge. Explore every corner, pay attention, and bring color back to this wonderful world.

Game Features:
	•	Unique visual style: each game looks like a detailed coloring book.
	•	4 unique locations to explore.
	•	100 adorable cats, masterfully hidden on each map.
	•	Color magic: tap a cat and it instantly turns vibrant.
	•	Entertaining gameplay: search, explore, and bring life to the world.
	•	Perfect for relaxation and wellness.


100 Korean Hidden Cats is a meditative adventure where every cat you find makes the world a little brighter. Look closely, notice the elusive, and become a master of the search in this cozy black-and-white universe. The world is waiting for you to add color—will you find them all?
